body: S170-138. REDGARDEN commit 1755667 (worktree branch worktree-redgarden-jungle-obstacles). Widened ARENA_HALF_EXTENT 20->28, rescaled the 5-node layout, added 22 static rock/tree obstacles in two mirrored jungle walls between each team's spawn and flank nodes with real circle-vs-circle collision in the shared update_hero_motion(), forcing top/bottom lane routing around flank nodes. Client renders trees/rocks as box silhouettes. test_arena.sh (390 assertions) passes unchanged; verified visually via Xvfb screenshot.
title: REDGARDEN arena jungle obstacles -- rocks/trees carve the map into lanes
